about: The official Custom UI type documentation (Hypixel Studios), as read through its mirror at hytalemodding.dev/en/docs/official-documentation/custom-ui/type-documentation on 2026-10-10 for game 0.6.8 and recorded, table by table, in the hytale-modding skill (references/research/custom-ui-format.md, sections 2.1 to 2.4). A property marked documented false is one that file measured in the release game's documents but the documentation leaves out. Converted by a script, not retyped. This is the only part of the property table that is not read from the installed game.
